0022600221.text: The Grizzlies host the Nuggets in their 11th game of the season, sitting at 7-3 overall with a win in their last outing, going 5-0 on the road but 2-3 at home, and holding 3rd place in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West. Denver comes in at 5-4 after a loss, 2 games back in 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West, with Julian Strawther out because of a knee sprain, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, while the Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-119 defeat in Denver on April 8, 2026. Memphis will be without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision.
